entities.summary: Ahmed Parker Yerima is a Nigerian academic, professor playwright and theater director. He was director-general of the Nigerian National Theatre, and has previously served as director of the National Troupe. He is a professor of Theater and Performing Arts and has been dean of the College of Humanities at Redeemer's University since 2013. Currently, he is the deputy vice- chancellor of Redeemer's University.
